about: Purpose: frozen oracle for render_fighters $BF13 -- one call per distinct path (at most a few each): SP at entry, the bytes it read before writing them as [addr, hex] runs (in; code and the tables $B500-$B9FF excepted), every byte it wrote outside the stack (out), its uncontended T (t) and its T in play (tc). Read by: python tools/rendfx.py --check, and the JS renderFighters gate.
